## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0148d307f05157221cd28d89f378ee2e850a6223`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/security.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/readings-queue.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/readings-shell.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs + scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs
Rule-change-verified: none

PR #38146 (slice 8 of card #35237: carrier items 3, 5, 6 and 11), net diff of the head against merge base `0e361201b2a6062cccaa1a2f7d37b82b3ed0465a`: 9 files, +24/-19. Read: the card body and all of its comments, the PR body, the file list, the net diff, the check-runs on the head, and the cited code in the head tree through `git show` (no checkout, nothing run).

Check-runs on the head: 49 runs, 26 success, 23 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. Success includes Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Check Changeset, PR-body guards and Governed Surface Queue Guard.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Hand-off reader accept set: unchanged — right.** `HANDOFF_TARGET` and `readContractReviewHandoff` are not in the diff. The reader still takes `l2-review#N`, `review#N`, `repo:NAME#N`, `epic:#N#k` and the retired `domain:LANE#N`. Only the writer-facing `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HANDOFF_TEMPLATE` changes; it now offers three spellings, each of which the regex on the head reads (checked by hand against the pattern: `l2-review#2`, `repo:objectstack#2`, `epic:#35205#1`). No line a seat already posted becomes unreadable.
- **Template and rule text move together — right.** `contract-review.md:23` carries the new template byte for byte in a code span; the existing verbatim pin holds it, and the new self-test case reads every offered shape back through the reader.
- **`--tier` printed text: one sentence replaced in the clause-② note and one in the suspicion line — right.** No script parses those sentences: across `scripts/`, `.github/` and `.claude/` the retired strings survive only as absence pins in the self-test and in the `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` docblock (carrier item 18). The MANDATORY lines that `coordinator.md` and `execution-duties.md` order quoted are untouched, so the tier derivation, the mandate rows and the suspect table are the same.
- **Published surface: none.** `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` only; no package, no schema, no export.
- **Byte ratchet: right.** Measured with `git cat-file -s` on base and head: contract-review 6418 → 6418, seat-lifecycle 9054 → 9052, cross-repo-coordination 4905 → 4903, lanes/security 4240 → 4236, readings-queue 9074 → 9067, readings-shell 2492 → 2490. All at or under their ceiling rows; no row moved.

### ② Semver level

- No published package is touched, so `skip-changeset` is right; Check Changeset is green on the head.
- Clause-②: `no` is right. The diff widens no published accept set and no public surface, and narrows none.
- Metadata-protocol: `none` is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` in os-dev-report 7234029267 is empty. Nothing to escalate.
- Dev flag, item 6 half done: confirmed and accepted. `round-open.mjs:112` pins `ROUND_PHRASE` = 「一轮(约 60 分钟)」 in `contract-review.md` (self-test at :647), and `round-open.mjs` is fenced out of this slice. The figure on `seat-lifecycle.md:5` is the number `ROUND_MINUTES` (:97) already reads. The remainder is carrier item 16 on the card.
- Dev flags, stale text outside the slice: confirmed in the head tree and carried as items 17–19 in card comment 7234043631 (`execution-duties.md:104`, `dispatch-gates.data.mjs:1578`, `area-lease.md:47`). None is in this diff.
- Dev flag, `check:i18n-coverage` not measured locally: answered by CI, Lint & Repo Gates is green on the head.
- Rule change: the PR body declares `Rule-change: none`, and the diff bears it out hunk by hunk.
  - `--tier` wording: copies rule text already on `main`. `execution-duties.md:104` reads 「不再移卡,开发与审核留接卡席」 and already calls the old sentence leftover script wording; `area-lease.md:47` and `cross-repo-coordination.md:41` say the same. The script now prints what the rule says.
  - Hand-off template: the rule on `contract-review.md:22` (hand to an L2 seat, else a sibling seat that can reach the tier) is unchanged. Only the spelling of the sibling seat follows the seat grammar the reader has taken since PR #37878.
  - Round length: `seat-lifecycle.md:5` names 60 minutes, the value `round-open.mjs` (the line's own named reading) already enforces. The self-exit rule and its order are unchanged.
  - Ancestry pointers and the byte-paying rewordings: a named script replaces a hand-typed command; each rule sentence is kept.
  - No hunk changes what an agent may do without the maintainer, what is done or in what order, or what must go to him.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff holds no data access, no id materialisation and no join.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Per file:

- **`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`** — holds. The clause-② note, the suspicion line and the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` docblock now agree with each other and with `execution-duties.md:104`. Tried to break it against the hand-off closed set on `area-lease.md:47` (another seat's claim, cloud routing, disclosure cards, ADR): none of those is triggered by a contract-surface hit, so the unconditional sentence does not overreach. The narrowing clause (「stays in its lane」) is untouched and matches `execution-duties.md:107`.
- **`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`** (implementing) — agrees. Both rewritten cases pin the new sentence present and the retired one absent, on the plain and the mandatory rendering and on the suspicion rendering; the surrounding retired-key comments still describe the cases beside them.
- **`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`** — holds. The rewritten docblock on the template is now true sentence by sentence: the verbatim pin ties rule text to the constant, the old `review#N` and the retired domain spelling are read and not offered, and the new case fills each placeholder shape and reads it through `readContractReviewHandoff` (target, lower-cased, and head). The case's `fill` maps each of the three shapes to a line the regex accepts; a fourth shape added without a reader arm turns it red.
- **`references/contract-review.md`** — holds. Line 23 equals the constant. Line 21's 「(照 `lanes/l2-review.md`)」 still points at the file whose 〈路由〉 section says which review seat to ask first; nothing is lost with 请谁.
- **`references/seat-lifecycle.md`** — holds. 「fire 后首个写动作前」 keeps the meaning; every phrase in `LIFECYCLE_PHRASES` (`round-open.mjs:101-109`) is still present on the head; `check-harness-current.mjs` exists at `scripts/pm/` and is named bare like its neighbours.
- **`references/cross-repo-coordination.md`** — holds. `git-history.mjs ancestor --commit=SHA --ref=SHA` is the CLI's own spelling (`git-history.mjs:17`, `:1095`); `--ref` resolves any commit, so a pin sha works. A shallow checkout now gets a refusal (exit 2) where raw git gave a false no, which is the stricter side for 「不过 ⇒ 改指 pin-bump 卡」.
- **`references/lanes/security.md`** — holds. A tag commit is a valid `--ref`; the ⛔ line on merge time versus tag time is unchanged.
- **`references/readings-queue.md`** — holds. With `--ref` omitted the default is `origin/main` (`git-history.mjs:288`), and the tool prints lower-case `no` for a squash-landed PR head in a complete clone; the lesson (read by content, never by head ancestry) stands.
- **`references/readings-shell.md`** — holds. Trap ④ keeps both failure modes; the reworded 127 line keeps its claim.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; none needs a new head):

- N1 (nit) — `execution-duties.md:104` still says `--tier` 仍印 the spec-lane sentence; after this PR it does not. Its operative clause stays right. Already carrier item 17 on the card; `dispatch-gates.data.mjs:1578` (item 18) and `area-lease.md:47` (item 19) are the same family.
- N2 (nit) — 「no longer moves the card」 is worded against the retired rule; once the old sentence is forgotten, 「does not move the card」 says the same. The self-test pins the current words, so a change rides the next opening of this file.
- N3 (nit) — the suspicion line's 「both by the claiming seat」 and the note's 「build and review stay with the claiming seat」 leave out the hand-off to an L2 seat when the tier cannot be reached. That route lives only in `contract-review.md` by its own rule, and the wording copies `execution-duties.md:104`, so nothing is wrong; a reader of the hint alone does not learn of the route.
- N4 (nit) — `record-recognisers.mjs`: the title of the verbatim-pin case still ends 「the template and `HANDOFF_TARGET` cannot drift apart」, the claim the docblock was just corrected away from; the new case is what makes it true. The neighbouring title 「the closed set of two shapes」 predates this PR.
- N5 (nit) — `readings-shell.md:11` names `git-history.mjs ancestor` after two failure modes; the `rev-list --count` one is answered by the same script's `count`, not by `ancestor`. Naming the script without the subcommand would cover both and cost fewer bytes.
- N6 (nit) — `seat-lifecycle.md:5` says 「一轮 60 分钟」 while `contract-review.md:25` says 「约 60 分钟」 and `SKILL.md:73` defines 一轮 as fire to queue empty. The parenthesis reads as the threshold of this line and matches the script exactly; item 16 already carries the `contract-review.md` side.

The new self-test fills each placeholder and reads it back through the unchanged `HANDOFF_TARGET`, so nothing already posted becomes unreadable. `contract-review.md` carries the same line verbatim.

N4 is a self-test title that still claims the template and `HANDOFF_TARGET` cannot drift apart; it is worth folding into the next slice.
